phases.label: Recurring work
phases.title:
Another run.
Familiar work.
phases.text: Check the variation. Compare the revision. Reconstruct the history. Different days bring back the same kinds of engineering work.

phases.label: Repeated response
phases.title:
The response shouldn’t
start over.
phases.text: Each task needs judgment. Rebuilding the same comparison, calculation or report every time adds work without adding understanding.

phases.label: Retained method
phases.title:
Keep the method.
Use it again.
phases.text: The useful part is the method: what to align, what to check, what context to preserve. Make that repeatable.

phases.label: Software
phases.title:
Give the method
an interface.
phases.text: A dedicated tool puts those steps within reach. The repeated work gains structure; the engineering decision remains yours.

phases.label: Accumulation
phases.title:
One need at a time.
Sixteen tools later.
phases.text: History, comparison, diagnosis, planning and reporting. Separate requirements gradually became the collection called ARTIFACTS.

situations.title: What happened during the run?
situations.evidence: Process events, wafer states and chamber counts.
situations.response: Reconstruct the lot history and review equipment usage.
situations.outcome: A traceable sequence, with usage in view.

situations.title: What changed between revisions?
situations.evidence: A reference and a revised recipe or Devices.XML file.
situations.response: Align corresponding steps or properties. Isolate the differences.
situations.outcome: Changes that can be reviewed in context.

situations.title: Where is the variation?
situations.evidence: Surface measurements and equipment parameter traces.
situations.response: Locate the region, find the chart, or inspect related signals over the same interval.
situations.outcome: Spatial and time context for the next investigation.

situations.title: What needs checking when temperature drifts?
situations.evidence: Temperature observations, baseplate inputs and zone geometry.
situations.response: Work through diagnostic checks and examine the relevant positions and regions.
situations.outcome: A structured investigation, with the physical context retained.

situations.title: What is due on the equipment?
situations.evidence: ANKO schedules, equipment status and due dates.
situations.response: Review the planned work alongside the current status.
situations.outcome: A clearer basis for maintenance planning.

situations.title: What evidence is ready for review?
situations.evidence: Metrology records, LayTec information and SPC parameter states.
situations.response: Compile reports or review the relevant release charts in their own tools.
situations.outcome: Structured reports and chart context for engineering review.
